findings.buyer_expectation: Motor harus berfungsi lebih lama dari beberapa minggu/penyalahgunaan ringan.
findings.merchant_question: Apakah ada informasi spesifik mengenai tipe/merek motor dan masa garansi pabrik untuk unit ini?

findings.buyer_expectation: Pembeli menganggap kapasitas lebih besar; foto/penulisan memberi impresi volume lebih dari 1 gelas.
findings.merchant_question: Apakah kapasitas 380ml diukur sampai penuh (brim) atau sampai batas aman penggunaan yang direkomendasikan?

findings.buyer_expectation: Pembeli mengharapkan pengiriman lebih cepat dari 8 hari.
findings.merchant_question: Berapa estimasi waktu pengiriman rata-rata dari gudang (hari kerja) untuk wilayah dalam negeri?

findings.buyer_expectation: Buyers expected the backpack to be waterproof and protect contents in heavy rain, but reviews report soaking in rain.
findings.merchant_question: Apakah bahan tas diberi lapisan tambahan (mis. coating PU) atau hanya poliester tanpa lapisan? Mohon konfirmasi agar kami bisa jelaskan di deskripsi.

text: Panjang kabel: panjang kabel 1 meter.

findings.buyer_expectation: Buyers expect the listing to state the cable length or offer length options so they can confirm it will reach between devices.
findings.draft_text: Panjang kabel: panjang kabel 1 meter.
findings.merchant_question: Berapa panjang kabel yang disertakan (dalam meter) untuk SKU ini, dan apakah ada varian panjang lain?

findings.buyer_expectation: Buyers expect the listing to state the cable length and/or offer length options so they can confirm it will reach between devices.
findings.merchant_question: Produk ini tersedia dalam panjang berapa saja? Mohon konfirmasi panjang pasti unit yang dikirim sehingga bisa saya tambahkan di listing.

text: Maksimal ketebalan kasur: cocok untuk kasur 160 x 200 cm dengan tebal maksimal 20 cm.

findings.buyer_expectation: Buyers expect the listing to state the maximum mattress thickness the 160x200 fitted sheet will cover so they can know if it fits their mattress.
findings.draft_text: Maksimal ketebalan kasur: cocok untuk kasur 160 x 200 cm dengan tebal maksimal 20 cm.
findings.merchant_question: Berapa maksimal ketebalan (cm) kasur yang sprei ukuran 160 x 200 ini bisa tutupi sampai bawah?

findings.buyer_expectation: Buyers expect the listing to state the maximum mattress thickness (depth) that the fitted sheet's elastic can accommodate so they know if it will cover their mattress.
findings.merchant_question: Berapa ketebalan maksimum kasur (dalam cm) yang dapat ditutup rapat oleh sprei ini sehingga karet masih sampai ke sudut kasur?

findings.buyer_expectation: Buyers expect a complete list of ingredients so they can check for allergens and active ingredients.
findings.merchant_question: Apa saja komposisi/kandungan lengkap produk (daftar INCI) yang tertera pada kemasan?

findings.buyer_expectation: Buyers want to know whether the serum contains alcohol (type and concentration) because of smell and allergy concerns.
findings.merchant_question: Apakah produk ini mengandung alkohol (mis. ethanol, denat, SD alcohol)? Jika ya, dapatkah dicantumkan jenis dan persentasenya?

findings.buyer_expectation: Buyers want a full composition/ingredient list to check for allergens and active brightening ingredients; reviews say composition is not written.
findings.merchant_question: Bisakah menyediakan daftar bahan lengkap (INCI) yang tercantum pada kemasan produk?

findings.buyer_expectation: Buyers expect timely delivery close to estimated times; listing does not set clear expectations so customers report long delays.
findings.merchant_question: Apakah Anda mencatat estimasi pengiriman/pengelola kurir yang digunakan dan rata-rata waktu pengiriman untuk produk ini?

findings.attribute: received wrong color / incorrect variant sent
findings.buyer_expectation: Buyers expect to receive the color/variant they ordered; some received a different color.
findings.merchant_question: Apakah Anda bisa cek mekanisme pemilihan dan pengepakan warna di gudang (apakah ada pemisahan SKU warna)?

text: Jenis konektor: konektor jack 3,5 mm; tidak ada versi USB-C atau Lightning.

findings.buyer_expectation: Buyers need to know the earphone plug type (3.5mm jack, USB-C, Lightning) and whether an adapter is included so they can use it with phones like iPhone 15 or phones without a headphone jack.
findings.draft_text: Jenis konektor: konektor jack 3,5 mm; tidak ada versi USB-C atau Lightning.
findings.merchant_question: Jenis konektor earphone ini apa (3.5mm jack / USB-C / Lightning)? Apakah paket termasuk adaptor untuk iPhone atau ponsel tanpa jack?

findings.buyer_expectation: Buyers expect to know what connector the earphones use (3.5mm jack, USB-C, Lightning) so they can tell if an adapter is needed or if it will plug directly into their phone.
findings.merchant_question: Apakah earphone ini menggunakan konektor 3.5mm (jack), USB-C, Lightning, atau jenis lain?

text: Panduan ukuran: panjang insole: 39 = 25 cm; 40 = 25,5 cm; 41 = 26 cm; 42 = 26,5 cm; 43 = 27 cm; 44 = 27,5 cm.

findings.buyer_expectation: Buyers expect a clear size guide (inner length or advice to choose true-to-size) because multiple buyers report sizes run large or non-standard.
findings.draft_text: Panduan ukuran: panjang insole: 39 = 25 cm; 40 = 25,5 cm; 41 = 26 cm; 42 = 26,5 cm; 43 = 27 cm; 44 = 27,5 cm.
findings.merchant_question: Berapa panjang insole (mm) untuk setiap nomor ukuran 39-44, atau ada rekomendasi pilih lebih kecil/lebih besar?

findings.buyer_expectation: Buyers expect to receive the size they ordered; at least one buyer received a different size.
findings.merchant_question: Apakah ada catatan packing/warehouse tentang kasus pengiriman ukuran berbeda (mis-pick) baru-baru ini?

findings.attribute_local: kecocokan tumit / mudah lepas di tumit
findings.buyer_expectation: Photos/description give general size range but buyers expect the slide to stay on; some report it is loose at the heel and comes off while walking.
findings.merchant_question: Apakah model ini memiliki strap/shape yang cenderung lebih longgar di area tumit atau ada variasi lebar antara batch produksi?

findings.buyer_expectation: Buyers expect timely delivery; one review reports slow shipping (~1 week).
findings.merchant_question: Apakah estimasi pengiriman yang biasa diberikan (WFS/fulfillment lead time) dan ada opsi pengiriman lebih cepat?

findings.attribute: size and fit (no measurements; runs large/inconsistent)
findings.attribute_local: ukuran dan kecocokan (tanpa panduan; cenderung kebesaran/tidak konsisten)
findings.buyer_expectation: Buyers expect clear size guidance (measurements or fit notes) and consistent sizing correspond to the labeled EU numbers.
findings.merchant_question: Apakah Anda bisa menyediakan panduan ukuran (panjang insole dalam cm untuk setiap nomor) atau catatan kecocokan (mis. cocok untuk kaki XX panjang/lebar)?

findings.buyer_expectation: Buyers expect to receive the size they ordered.
findings.merchant_question: Bisa cek proses fulfilment: apakah ada masalah packing/labeling yang menyebabkan ukuran/varian salah dikirim?

findings.attribute: heel retention (slides slip off heel / loose at heel)
findings.attribute_local: cengkraman tumit (longgar di tumit, mudah lepas)
findings.buyer_expectation: Buyers expect the slide to stay on the foot when walking (secure heel fit).
findings.merchant_question: Apakah ada variasi cetakan/ukuran pada upper yang menyebabkan beberapa nomor jadi longgar di tumit? (minta tim produksi cek toleransi mould/upper)

findings.buyer_expectation: Buyers notice and expect either no strong chemical/rubber smell or guidance that airing removes it.
findings.merchant_question: Apakah produk ini dikemas baru tanpa proses airing? Bisa ditambahkan catatan bila ada bau pabrik yang biasanya hilang setelah dijemur?

findings.buyer_expectation: Buyers expect delivery within a reasonable timeframe or clear shipping lead-time stated.
findings.merchant_question: Berapa lead time standar pengiriman (hari kerja) dan apakah ada opsi pengiriman lebih cepat yang bisa ditampilkan di listing?
